purpose: Verify an authenticated employee can submit a complete purchase indent and that its identifier, timestamp, and creation action are recorded.
preconditions: An authenticated employee account is available.
action_or_input: Enter item details, quantity, estimated cost, and justification, then submit the indent.
expected_result: The indent is submitted with the entered information, a unique identifier and submission timestamp; its creation is present in the audit trail.

purpose: Verify mandatory indent fields are validated before submission.
preconditions: An authenticated employee is creating an indent.
action_or_input: Leave a mandatory indent field empty and submit.
expected_result: Submission is not accepted while a mandatory field is missing.

purpose: Verify potential duplicate indents are detected and flagged for review.
preconditions: A previously submitted indent exists with details that can be used to create a potential duplicate.
action_or_input: Submit another indent with details matching the previous indent sufficiently to trigger potential-duplicate detection.
expected_result: The system flags the new indent as a potential duplicate for review.

purpose: Verify a permissible-state indent can be modified and each modification is retained as a distinct version.
preconditions: An employee owns an indent in a state configured as permissible for modification.
action_or_input: Modify the indent and save the change.
expected_result: The modification is accepted and retained as a distinct indent version.

purpose: Verify an indent cannot be modified outside a permissible state.
preconditions: An employee owns an indent in a state configured as not permissible for modification.
action_or_input: Attempt to modify the indent.
expected_result: The modification is not permitted.

purpose: Verify withdrawal or cancellation is permitted only in a permissible state.
preconditions: An employee owns an indent in a state configured as permissible for withdrawal or cancellation.
action_or_input: Withdraw or cancel the indent.
expected_result: The withdrawal or cancellation is accepted.

purpose: Verify withdrawal or cancellation is not permitted outside a permissible state.
preconditions: An employee owns an indent in a state configured as not permissible for withdrawal or cancellation.
action_or_input: Attempt to withdraw or cancel the indent.
expected_result: The withdrawal or cancellation is not permitted.

purpose: Verify a previous indent can be repeated as a new editable draft.
preconditions: A previous indent exists and the employee is authorized to access it.
action_or_input: Repeat the previous indent as a new draft, change its details, and inspect it before submission.
expected_result: A new draft based on the previous indent is available and its details can be changed before submission.

purpose: Verify logged indent actions are visible to stakeholders authorized for the indent.
preconditions: An indent has logged actions and a relevant stakeholder is authorized to access it.
action_or_input: Have the authorized stakeholder view the indent action history.
expected_result: The stakeholder can view the logged indent actions.

purpose: Verify stock checks occur before external procurement and available stock is reported and reserved for internal issue.
preconditions: Departmental or central stock records contain requested items and sufficient allocable stock.
action_or_input: Submit an indent for those items and proceed through the stock availability check.
expected_result: The system checks departmental and central stock before external procurement, informs the requestor that the items are present in stock records, and reserves available stock allocated to the indent before internal issue.

purpose: Verify stock reservations are included in availability so stock cannot be over-committed.
preconditions: Stock is available and already reserved for an indent.
action_or_input: Submit another indent that would require stock already reserved for the first indent.
expected_result: The system accounts for the existing reservation when determining available stock and does not over-commit it.

purpose: Verify an approved internal issue can be picked, dispatched, acknowledged, and posted after delivery confirmation.
preconditions: An internal issue is approved.
action_or_input: As Department Admin, schedule picking and dispatch; have the requestor acknowledge receipt.
expected_result: Picking and dispatch can be scheduled, receipt can be acknowledged, and final stock posting occurs after delivery is confirmed.

purpose: Verify final stock posting does not occur before delivery confirmation.
preconditions: An internal issue has been dispatched but delivery has not been confirmed.
action_or_input: Check the stock posting before the requestor confirms delivery.
expected_result: Final stock posting has not occurred.

purpose: Verify final stock posting is blocked while a receipt has an unresolved discrepancy.
preconditions: An internal issue has a confirmed delivery with an unresolved discrepancy.
action_or_input: Attempt to complete final stock posting.
expected_result: Final stock posting is not completed while the discrepancy remains unresolved.

purpose: Verify indent approval routing follows the configured cost-threshold hierarchy.
preconditions: The applicable approval hierarchy and cost thresholds are configured; an indent has a known cost.
action_or_input: Submit the indent into the approval workflow.
expected_result: The indent is routed through the configured approval hierarchy according to the applicable cost thresholds.

purpose: Verify recorded indent priority is used for policy-permitted direct approval handling, SLA notifications, and approval-queue priority.
preconditions: A Department Admin can record priority; configured policy permits a more direct path for the selected higher-priority indent.
action_or_input: Record a higher priority for the indent and submit it into the configured approval workflow.
expected_result: The priority is recorded and used in approval-queue prioritization and SLA notifications; the more direct approval path is followed where permitted by configured policy.

purpose: Verify rejection requires a justification.
preconditions: An indent is awaiting an approver decision.
action_or_input: Attempt to reject the indent without entering a justification.
expected_result: The rejection is not accepted without a justification.

purpose: Verify an approver can reject an indent with justification and the decision is audited.
preconditions: An indent is awaiting an approver decision.
action_or_input: Reject the indent with a justification.
expected_result: The rejection is recorded with its justification and the approval decision is present in the audit trail.

purpose: Verify SLA reminders and configured escalation notifications for pending approval actions.
preconditions: An approval action is pending; reminder and escalation conditions are configured.
action_or_input: Allow the configured reminder and escalation conditions to be met.
expected_result: The system issues an SLA-based reminder and issues an escalation notification when the configured escalation conditions are met.

purpose: Verify an indent proceeds to external procurement when sufficient stock is unavailable.
preconditions: The automatic stock check finds insufficient stock for the indent.
action_or_input: Complete the stock check for the indent.
expected_result: The indent is routed for external procurement.

purpose: Verify procurement method is determined using configured value thresholds.
preconditions: Direct-versus-tender value thresholds are configured; an indent value is available.
action_or_input: Process the indent for external procurement.
expected_result: The system determines whether direct procurement or tender procurement applies using the configured value thresholds.

purpose: Verify the tender workflow supports publication, bid recording, criteria-based evaluation, committee approval, and traceable decision records.
preconditions: An indent is routed to tender procurement; tender evaluation criteria are defined.
action_or_input: Publish the tender invitation, record submitted bids, evaluate them against the defined criteria, and record committee approval of the selection.
expected_result: The tender invitation is published, bids are received and recorded, evaluation against defined criteria and committee approval of the selection are supported, and the procurement decision and supporting records are retained traceably.

purpose: Verify an approved purchase order is linked to its indent and selected vendor and vendor master is validated before issuance.
preconditions: Required approvals are complete; a selected vendor exists and can be validated.
action_or_input: Create and issue a purchase order for the indent and selected vendor.
expected_result: The purchase order can be created after required approvals, is linked to its originating indent and selected vendor, and vendor master validation occurs before issuance.

purpose: Verify a purchase order cannot be created before required approvals are complete.
preconditions: Required approvals for an indent are incomplete.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a purchase order for that indent.
expected_result: Purchase-order creation is not permitted before required approvals are complete.

purpose: Verify purchase-order status and delivery schedule information are centrally tracked.
preconditions: A purchase order exists with planned delivery schedule information.
action_or_input: Record an actual delivery schedule update and view the purchase order centrally.
expected_result: The current purchase-order status and planned and actual delivery schedule information are tracked centrally.

purpose: Verify authorized inspection, GRN creation, partial receipt, and rejection are supported.
preconditions: A purchase order has delivered goods; the inspector is an authorized Requestor, Department Admin, or Department Head.
action_or_input: Record an inspection, receive part of the ordered quantity, reject delivered goods as applicable, and create the GRN for recorded deliveries.
expected_result: The authorized actor can record the inspection; the system creates a GRN and supports recording partial receipt and rejection during receipt and inspection.

purpose: Verify external-procurement stock is updated only after receipt is accepted.
preconditions: Externally procured goods have been delivered but not accepted.
action_or_input: Inspect the goods and check stock before accepting the receipt.
expected_result: Stock is not updated for the goods before receipt acceptance.

purpose: Verify accepted externally procured receipt quantities are reflected in stock.
preconditions: Externally procured goods have been received and accepted.
action_or_input: Complete receipt processing and inspect stock.
expected_result: Stock is updated for the accepted receipt quantities.

purpose: Verify delivery discrepancies or damages can be logged with evidence retained.
preconditions: A delivery has a discrepancy or damage and supporting evidence is available.
action_or_input: Log the discrepancy or damage against the delivery and attach the evidence.
expected_result: The discrepancy or damage is logged against the delivery and its evidence is retained.

purpose: Verify policy-governed return and replacement case initiation and case status/resolution tracking.
preconditions: A discrepancy case exists and applicable policy indicates return or replacement is required.
action_or_input: Initiate a return or replacement case under the applicable policy and update its status and resolution.
expected_result: The applicable return or replacement can be initiated, and the case's current status and resolution are tracked.

purpose: Verify vendor communications and case status/resolution are recorded for discrepancy, return, replacement, or warranty resolution.
preconditions: A discrepancy, return, replacement, or warranty case exists.
action_or_input: Record vendor communication on the case and update its status and resolution.
expected_result: The vendor communication is recorded and the case's current status and resolution are tracked.

purpose: Verify required inventory and accounting adjustments are applied when a case is resolved.
preconditions: A discrepancy, return, or replacement case is resolved; applicable policy specifies inventory and accounting adjustments.
action_or_input: Complete the resolution and inspect the related inventory and accounting records.
expected_result: Required inventory and accounting adjustments are applied according to policy.

purpose: Verify three-way matching of purchase order, GRN, and invoice is supported.
preconditions: A purchase order, related GRN, and invoice are available.
action_or_input: Submit the invoice for verification and perform three-way matching.
expected_result: The system supports matching the purchase order, GRN, and invoice.

purpose: Verify payment release requires delivery confirmation and satisfied invoice verification conditions.
preconditions: An invoice is pending payment; delivery confirmation or required invoice verification conditions are not yet satisfied.
action_or_input: Attempt to release payment.
expected_result: Payment is not released until delivery is confirmed and required verification conditions are satisfied.

purpose: Verify payment can be released when delivery and required verification conditions are satisfied.
preconditions: Delivery is confirmed and required invoice verification conditions are satisfied.
action_or_input: Release payment.
expected_result: Payment release is permitted.

purpose: Verify a mismatched invoice is placed on hold.
preconditions: A submitted invoice does not match the purchase order and GRN.
action_or_input: Perform invoice matching.
expected_result: The mismatched invoice is placed on hold.

purpose: Verify partial payments follow configured payment rules.
preconditions: Payment rules are configured; a payment eligible for processing is available.
action_or_input: Process a partial payment according to the configured rules.
expected_result: The system supports the partial payment in accordance with the configured payment rules.

purpose: Verify vendor onboarding and master-data maintenance, including version and audit history.
preconditions: A user authorized to manage vendor data is available.
action_or_input: Onboard a new vendor, then update its vendor master data.
expected_result: Vendor onboarding and master-data maintenance are supported; the master change is retained in version history and recorded in the audit trail.

purpose: Verify vendor GST details, bank details, and required compliance documents are validated.
preconditions: A user is entering or updating vendor master data.
action_or_input: Enter vendor master data with a missing or invalid GST detail, bank detail, or required compliance document and submit it for validation.
expected_result: The system validates the GST details, bank details, and required compliance documents.

purpose: Verify PO issuance and payment are prevented for an unverified vendor.
preconditions: A purchase order or payment is being processed for an unverified vendor.
action_or_input: Attempt to issue the purchase order and attempt to release payment to the vendor.
expected_result: The purchase order is not issued and payment is not released for the unverified vendor.

source_id: AFR-PSM-067, AFR-PSM-068, AFR-PSM-069, AFR-PSM-070, AFR-PSM-071, AFR-PSM-072, AFR-PSM-073
purpose: Verify the inter-departmental stock transfer lifecycle, ledger updates on completion, and transfer audit trail.
preconditions: A source department has approved stock available for transfer to a destination department.
action_or_input: Create a transfer request, reserve the approved stock, dispatch it, confirm receipt, and inspect both stock ledgers and the transfer audit history.
expected_result: The request can be created, stock reserved, transfer dispatched and receipt confirmed; upon completion, source and destination ledgers are updated and the transfer audit trail is retained.

purpose: Verify operational, procurement, stock, and procurement/payment financial reports are provided.
preconditions: An authorized user can access purchase and stores reporting.
action_or_input: Request an operational report, procurement report, stock report, and financial report related to procurement and payments.
expected_result: The system provides all four report categories to the authorized user.

purpose: Verify report filtering, export, scheduling, and logging of every generation event.
preconditions: An authorized user can access reports and supported report criteria are available.
action_or_input: Filter report data using a supported criterion, generate and export the report, and schedule report generation; inspect generation logs.
expected_result: Report data can be filtered, generated reports exported, and report generation scheduled; each report generation event is logged.

purpose: Verify dashboards show real-time process status and key metrics.
preconditions: An authorized user can access the dashboard; process and metric data are available.
action_or_input: View the dashboard and compare displayed status and metrics with current system data.
expected_result: The dashboard shows real-time process status and key purchase-and-stores metrics.

purpose: Verify automated notifications are generated for indent submission and approval events.
preconditions: An indent can be submitted and processed through an approval event.
action_or_input: Submit an indent and record an approval event.
expected_result: Automated notifications are generated for both indent submission and approval events.

purpose: Verify alerts are generated for dispatch, receipt, invoice, and payment status events.
preconditions: A purchase lifecycle can generate dispatch, receipt, invoice, and payment status events.
action_or_input: Trigger each of the dispatch, receipt, invoice, and payment status events.
expected_result: An alert is generated for each specified status event.

purpose: Verify SLA reminders and escalations are generated and module communication history is retained.
preconditions: SLA reminder and escalation conditions are configured and can be met.
action_or_input: Trigger the configured SLA reminder and escalation conditions, then inspect module communication history.
expected_result: SLA reminder and escalation notifications are generated and the communication history is retained.

purpose: Verify module actions are maintained in a complete audit trail.
preconditions: A module action can be performed by an authorized user.
action_or_input: Perform a module action and inspect the audit trail.
expected_result: The audit trail records module actions, including the performed action.

purpose: Verify purchase and stores records are available to support internal and statutory audits.
preconditions: Purchase and stores records exist; an auditor is authorized for the relevant audit scope.
action_or_input: Access purchase and stores records for internal audit and statutory audit.
expected_result: The system supports both internal and statutory audit of purchase and stores records.

purpose: Verify role-based access control for module functions and information.
preconditions: A user with an authorized role and a user without authorization for a selected function or information are available.
action_or_input: Attempt the function or information access as the authorized user and as the unauthorized user.
expected_result: Role-based access control permits access according to the authorized role and denies access when the role is not authorized.

purpose: Verify configured procurement-policy constraints are enforced.
preconditions: An applicable procurement-policy constraint is represented by a configured business rule.
action_or_input: Attempt a procurement action that violates the configured constraint.
expected_result: The system enforces the configured procurement-policy constraint.

purpose: Verify configured financial-policy constraints are enforced.
preconditions: An applicable financial-policy constraint is represented by a configured business rule.
action_or_input: Attempt a financial action that violates the configured constraint.
expected_result: The system enforces the configured financial-policy constraint.
